title: The Bethl'mite
tagline: A free monthly postcard of Bethlehem shows, filled from a site I built.
what: The Bethl'mite is a free monthly postcard of live concerts and obscure happenings around Bethlehem, PA. I built the website behind it: bands and venues send in shows, artists send in art for the front, and a map shows where to grab a card.
built: Built four parts: the public site, plus pages for the crew, the venues and the shops that carry cards
A pickup map with its own pin for each of the 9 spots that hand out cards
An issue builder: drag the month's shows into order and see the postcard take shape
Bands, venues and artists can send in shows and art without making an account
starring: A local postcard crew, plus the venues, artists and shops around it

making.problem: Every month a print-only postcard needs shows from bands and venues, art for the front, and a list of where to pick it up. I wanted all of that in one place.
how: Bands, venues and artists send in shows and art, no account needed
The crew approves or turns down each one, with a reason
Approved shows get dragged into order for the month's card
Shops sign up to carry cards and land on the map once approved
credits: Map tiles and the backup address lookup come from OpenStreetMap
Addresses get matched first by the US Census geocoder
Drag and drop by dnd-kit, maps drawn with Leaflet

moment.what: All 9 pickup spots have their own pin on the map. Someone looking for the postcard can find a place to grab one, while the crew puts the next issue together.
